{
  "name": "image-view",
  "description": "See the images you paste into Claude Code as big previews above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] tags",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "author": {
    "name": "joshhu",
    "url": "https://github.com/joshhu"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/joshhu/claudebigimage",
  "repository": "https://github.com/joshhu/claudebigimage",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "images",
    "paste",
    "preview",
    "thumbnails",
    "mod",
    "terminal",
    "claude-code"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "maxHeight": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max image height (rows)",
      "description": "Tallest an image preview may be, in terminal rows. It still shrinks to fit the space above the prompt.",
      "default": 20,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 255
    },
    "maxWidth": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max image width (columns)",
      "description": "Widest an image preview may be, in terminal columns. It still shrinks to fit the terminal's width.",
      "default": 80,
      "min": 4,
      "max": 255
    }
  }
}
